companies.sub: 産業オートメーション

relations.text: Flowserveが10-Kで、バルブの最大級の競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Flowserve lists Emerson first among its largest valve competitors

source.label: Flowserve 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Some of the largest valve industry competitors include Emerson Electric Co., Cameron International Corp. (a Schlumberger company), Baker Hughes, Rotork plc, Valmet, IMI Plc and Crane Co.

relations.text: Baker Hughesが10-Kで、主な競合の一社として挙げる(Flowserveもバルブの競合に挙げる)
relations.text_en: Baker Hughes names Flowserve among main competitors (and vice versa for valves)

source.label: Baker Hughes 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: IET main competitors include Siemens Energy, Solar (a Caterpillar company), Mitsubishi Heavy Industry, Sulzer, Flowserve, and Emerson.

relations.text: Chartの合併解約に伴う違約金など2.58億ドルをFlowserveに支払った
relations.text_en: Paid Flowserve $258 million in termination fees on Chart's behalf

source.label: Baker Hughes 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we paid $258 million for the termination fee and the reimbursement of certain expenses on behalf of Chart to Flowserve Corporation ("Flowserve")
